method: Manual in-app browser interaction with the freshly installed CLI demo, served locally. Accessible page state inspected after each action.
cases: Blank input plus Inspect clears old detail/ancestry/children and shows invalid-ID message.
Valid 1640 plus Enter restores correct detail and ancestry.
Fractional 1.5 plus Enter after valid selection clears old detail and ancestry.
Valid 1640 restores again; clicking parent 1618 shows parent 1609 and children 1624,1631,1640.
limitations: Not automated browser coverage, cross-browser certification or a screen-reader speech test.
